scientific_question: Do repeated capitulum-trait changes occur during environmental regimes or changes that are independently consistent with the present spatial gradients recovered by Azami, and does that multi-layer agreement strengthen a specified selection-pressure hypothesis?

programme_axes.azami_space: present-day phenotype sorting along geographic environmental gradients, estimated separately within and among taxa
programme_axes.eazami_time: repeated trait history, relative placement, bounded event-age windows and environmental level/change/variability through those windows
programme_axes.mechanism_fitness: independent trait-to-function mediator and reproductive-fitness evidence required for an adaptive explanation

calendar_context.source: Moreyra et al. 2025, Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution 204:108285, DOI 10.1016/j.ympev.2025.108285
calendar_context.prohibition: Do not assign a Japanese trait transition to 2.4 Ma or scale relative lineage-depth by 2.4 Ma.

current_history_inputs.topology_ensemble: accepted ML plus 1000 UFBoot histories for minimum-change and relative-depth analyses
current_history_inputs.relative_lineage_depth_semantics: one is terminal; lower values subtend broader descendant lineages; topology only

orientation.relative_timing: mixed internal-to-terminal; UFBoot median lower-upper mean-depth envelope 0.7952-0.9943

phyllary_posture.relative_timing: broad/deeper placements remain admissible; median envelope 0.6952-1.0000

exact_dated_tree.requirement: machine-readable dated tree or posterior with exact tip/node crosswalk to admitted Japan38 concepts
exact_dated_tree.current_state: not identified in the accepted repository bundle
exact_dated_tree.stop_rule: No exact event-age analysis from a published figure or article-level node summary.

paleolocation.requirement: predeclared ancestral-area or alternative-location scenarios for each change-bearing lineage
paleolocation.stop_rule: Do not extract one modern tip coordinate as the location of an ancestral branch.

primary_paleoclimate_asset.name: PALEO-PGEM-Series
primary_paleoclimate_asset.uncertainty_rule: Use both the emulator mean and supplied uncertainty; retain precipitation/downscaling and fixed-land-sea-mask limitations.
sources: Barreto et al. 2023, Global Ecology and Biogeography, DOI 10.1111/geb.13683
Holden et al. 2019, Geoscientific Model Development, DOI 10.5194/gmd-12-5137-2019

event_window_definition.per_change_edge: calendar interval from the dated parent node to dated child node
event_window_definition.history_uncertainty: For each topology, propagate all globally minimum-cost histories as lower and upper event-exposure envelopes rather than assigning equal probability to histories.
event_window_definition.age_uncertainty: Propagate dated-tree posterior or reported node-age uncertainty jointly with topology uncertainty.
event_window_definition.no_point_date_rule: A transition is not assigned to a midpoint or a single calendar age unless an independent event model identifies it.

predeclared_temporal_environment_estiman.environment_level: mean climate within the admissible event window and paleolocation scenario
predeclared_temporal_environment_estiman.environment_change: net and absolute climate change across the parent-child interval, normalized by window duration only when dated uncertainty permits
predeclared_temporal_environment_estiman.environment_variability: within-window temporal variance and upper-tail exposure using the 1-kyr series
predeclared_temporal_environment_estiman.regime_extremeness: event-window metric relative to the same lineage/location background distribution
predeclared_temporal_environment_estiman.matched_non_event_null: Randomize the same number of event windows among eligible branches while preserving branch duration, topology opportunity and paleolocation scenario; repeat over topology/age uncertainty
predeclared_temporal_environment_estiman.multiple_testing: One frozen family per trait x predeclared environmental domain; no all-BIOCLIM fishing screen

orientation.reason: Azami identifies an among-taxon BIO12 gradient; EAzami identifies a stable BIO15 direction and a scale-dependent BIO1 direction.
orientation.decision_if_positive: Promote hydric exposure from T2 cross-axis candidate to T3 historical-environment alignment; still not adaptation.
orientation.decision_if_negative: Retain present spatial/current-niche correspondence but reject the claim that known transition windows preferentially coincide with the tested paleohydric regimes.
orientation.decision_if_unresolved: Report temporal alignment as not identifiable because event windows, paleolocation or paleoclimate uncertainty are too broad.

phyllary_posture.reason: A homologous Azami spatial axis and state-diverse ecology are absent; enemy and access histories lack a deep-time predictor.
phyllary_posture.decision: No paleoclimate event test until direct posture measurement and a predeclared driver exist.

stickiness.reason: The shallow repeated history suggests a local biotic/cost hypothesis, but no historical enemy series or homologous Azami axis exists and a direct Cirsium result weakens universal defence.
stickiness.decision: Do not use coarse climate variables as a post hoc proxy for enemy pressure.

colour.reason: Azami RSDS-chroma sorting is robust, but a repeated colour-event history and defensible deep-time surface-radiation series are absent.
colour.decision: Resolve calibrated population-matched colour history before any temporal radiation test.

explanatory_evidence_tiers.T0: trait measured or mechanism proposed, without matched space-time evidence
explanatory_evidence_tiers.T1: one independent axis supports a pattern: spatial gradient, repeated history or mechanism prior
explanatory_evidence_tiers.T2: the same trait has repeated history plus an independently concordant present spatial/current-niche environmental domain
explanatory_evidence_tiers.T3: dated transition-window analysis independently aligns repeated events with the predeclared environmental level, change or variability
explanatory_evidence_tiers.T4: direct manipulation or mediator analysis validates trait-to-function under the relevant environment
explanatory_evidence_tiers.T5: the trait-to-function path reaches reproductive fitness in ancestry-resolved repeated lineages; adaptive explanation becomes supportable within the tested scope

current_tier_decisions.stickiness_enemy_cost: T1 repeated history with generic-defence model weakened
current_tier_decisions.whole_capitulum_common_lability: negative constraint: universal synchronized history not supported

interpretation_rules: Concordance is domain-specific and trait-specific; it is not a vote count across heterogeneous tests.
BIO12 and BIO15 are distinct hydric dimensions and must not be described as the same coefficient reproducing.
A mismatch may reflect biological scale, mean versus variability, ontology mismatch, current niche versus ancestral environment, reticulation, sampling or a genuinely different selection pressure.
Missing comparable data are not classified as ecological discordance.
T3 historical alignment remains observational and cannot establish selection without T4 mechanism and T5 fitness evidence.
forbidden_claims: calendar dates derived from relative lineage-depth
ancestral climate inferred from present taxon centroids
adaptive radiation demonstrated from repeated states and climate alignment alone
